def: to share or participate; by implication, belong to, eat (or drink)
kjv: be partaker, pertain, take part, use

occurrences.text: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.
For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
